notes.title: Donation DLC Release
notes.content:
[h3]Hey Touchers-of-art![/h3]

I am overwhelmed with the positive reactions this game has received since its release earlier this year. We've reached more than [b]4000 [/b]reviews and a [b]99%[/b] positive to negative ratio making it one of the [b]top 10 best rated games on Steam in 2024[/b]!
[i][b]!!! THIS IS INSANE !!! [/b][/i]

[h2]First of all: there will be a sequel! [/h2]
[h2]Here's how you can help to make this happen:[/h2]

Many people have written they would have paid for this game (or would still like to pay for it) and so I thought about a way for them to do this without compromising the free nature of the original product (which will always stay 100% free!). 

[h3]DLC's[/h3]

I’ve introduced 3 DLC’s that are [i][b]PURELY COSMETIC[/b][/i]. 
This means they won’t influence the gameplay and only add visual changes to the game.
They are meant to support me in making more games like these (more about that later!)
However, I did want to [b]give you something in return[/b] to there are 3 features you can unlock:

[list]
[*] Your name will be mentioned in the credits of the game as seen on the screenshot.
[*] Your Steam Avatar is a painting somewhere in the game. It's still a hidden object game, so it's up to you to find it!
[*] Your Steam Friends are shown as paintings somewhere in the game. It's still a hidden object game, so it's up to you to find them![/list]

The large donation (Donation L) unlocks all 3 features.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3351000/Please_Touch_The_Artwork_2__Donation_L/

The medium donation (Donation M) the first 2 features.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3350990/Please_Touch_The_Artwork_2__Donation_M/

The small donation (Donation S) unlocks only the first feature.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3350980/Please_Touch_The_Artwork_2__Donation_S/

Thank you for your support.
Merry Christmas, and a happy new year!

notes.title: Update Notes April 5th
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Bugfix (gamepad + Steamdeck) in The City where you couldn’t move in the painting with the lady in front of the window.
[*] SteamDeck: show onscreen keyboard for inputfields
[*] SteamDeck: automatically show/hide hand when playing with gamepad vs touchscreen
[*] SteamDeck: disabled windowmode and resolution selection because resolution is fixed
[*] Added numbers to levelnames to avoid confusion in level-order
[*] Made level names also clickable to start level
[*] Small fixes & improvements
[/list]
